title: Yesterday's World
lyrics:
[00:00.36] Time is an interesting phenomenon
[00:04.63] A ticking clock, the running sand, an hourglass
[00:09.43] All these have captured the imagination of men
[00:13.04] But time is more, it exists now, and then, and in the future
[00:20.57] Suppose we are in the year 1950
[00:24.05] Co-existence in time, maybe worlds we have never seen
[00:28.49] The world of the past, and of the future
[01:09.48] Yesterday's world
[01:14.23] Seems so far away these days
[01:26.66] Yesterday's dreams
[01:30.70] Seem just so right to me these days
[01:41.57] Can we go back in time?
[01:46.08] Can we go back in time?
[01:50.31] Can we go back in time?
[01:54.57] Can we go back in time?
[02:01.70] Captain, I detected a temporal disturbance
[02:06.35] Disturbance is spherical in shape
[02:09.64] It appears that within the disturbance
[02:11.15] Time is moving at an accelerated rate
[02:14.18] Approximately fifty times faster than normal
[02:18.07] Yesterday seems
[02:22.64] Just so far away these days
[02:35.28] Yesterday's dreams
[02:39.48] Feel just so far away from these days
[02:50.58] Can we go back in time?
[02:54.73] Can we go back in time?
[02:58.83] Can we go back in time?
[03:03.18] Can we go back in time?
[03:28.36] No, no, I won't go back
[03:31.52] No, no, no
[03:35.47] Sue, Sue, Sue
[03:36.82] Wake up honey, honey, it's all over
[03:39.46] We can relax
[03:41.60] Where are we?
[03:42.67] We're still in 1950, it's alright
[03:45.93] You must've had a nightmare
[03:47.76] I was
[03:49.36] It was awful, Bill
[03:52.31] You have just heard another adventure
[03:53.99] Into the unknown world of the future
[03:56.93]
